title: Aging in place
summary: The parts of the CDC STEADI home fall-prevention checklist that the floor plan can test, plus bed and bath on the entry floor.

rules.text: The path from the entrance through the main rooms is wide enough to walk without stepping around things: 36 in (914 mm) between walls. Furniture is not in the scan, so this is the most room there can be.
rules.standard: CDC STEADI 'Check for Safety' (floors: is there a clear path when you walk through a room); width from ADA 2010 Standards 403.5.1

rules.text: The night-time route from each bedroom to the nearest bathroom on the same floor is at least 36 in (914 mm) wide, so a walker fits. The route length is in each finding.
rules.standard: CDC STEADI 'Check for Safety' (bedrooms: the path from bed to bathroom); width from ADA 2010 Standards 403.5.1

rules.text: No raised threshold or single step at a doorway (over 1/2 in, 13 mm). Steps found here are trip hazards to fix first.
rules.standard: CDC STEADI 'Check for Safety' (floors and stairs: uneven steps); limit from ADA 2010 Standards 303.3

rules.text: A bedroom and a bathroom are on the floor with the entrance, so stairs are not needed day to day.
rules.standard: AARP HomeFit Guide (bedroom and full bathroom on the main level)

rules.text: If the home has stairs, check handrails on both sides for the full length and a light switch at the top and bottom. The scan cannot see either.
rules.standard: CDC STEADI 'Check for Safety' (stairs and steps)
